title: Find a value by key
summary: Objective-C: Find a value by key. Read pages and use intValue.
introduction: NSDictionary connects keys to values. A text key can describe the data.
learningObjectives: Find a value by key with Objective-C

blocks.text: On a Mac with Xcode command-line tools, save lesson.m. Run clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation lesson.m -o lesson, then ./lesson.

blocks.title: Find a value by key

blocks.text: The title key selects its NSString. UTF8String reads that value for printing.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Numbers in object collections need boxing such as @24.
